Message from ORA

From the ORA eTraining module "Post Award Quick Guide" (lesson 1 of 9).
Congratulations on Your Award!
The Office of Research Administration is ready to provide support and guidance through the post-award administration of your project. We are excited to witness the impact that this grant will undoubtedly have on advancing knowledge and making a meaningful difference in your field. Your hard work and passion have truly paid off, and we couldn't be more proud of your well-deserved success! In this Post-Award module we will review topics ranging from cost allowability to requirements for reporting to funding agencies.
Contact Us
If you have any questions regarding the material covered, or any general questions regarding the operation of your grant, please feel encouraged to send an email to ask.ora@morgan.edu .
